title: Pricing — quote, counter, discount ask
planted: peculiarity: light hinglish code-switch (honesty test — pipeline should flag reduced confidence on non-english spans, not drop or hallucinate them)

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Got your call-volume report, thanks. Based on that, here's where we land — twenty eight per seat per month, all five locations, routing, texting and the recall tooling included.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Twenty eight. Achha. So here's my problem, Maya — RingHawk came back the moment they smelled a switch and offered twenty two to renew.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: They discounted after three years of ignored tickets. What does that tell you about the next three years?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Nahi, I know, I know. But I answer to Dr. Mehta on this, and he signs the checks. He's going to see a six dollar gap per seat and ask me why.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Then let's give you the answer. Ten bookings a week recovered after hours pays that gap at one location, let alone five.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: That math works on me. On him, thoda tough. Can you do fifteen percent? That gets me close enough that the conversation is about service, not price.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Fifteen across the board, nahi — that I can't do. What I can do is sharpen it if we commit to a pilot structure — let me come back to you on exact numbers.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Theek hai. Timing matters here. The RingHawk renewal is end of November, and if I'm switching I need to know before they auto-renew me.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Understood, that's our clock then. Anything else standing between you and a yes?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: One thing that spooked me. The old vendor told us back in the day that porting numbers takes months. If that's true it blows up your weekend cutover story.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: It's not true, and I'll prove it rather than argue it. The port request paperwork goes in on day one and I'll show you real timelines from practices your size.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Bas, do that. Bring me a sharper number and the porting proof, na, and then I take it to Dr. Mehta.
